# Third-party verifier attribution

The verifier directory contains unchanged checker sources and data from SAIRcompetition/Andrews-Curtis, commit a0fd6e6f52d82c93ccc06ab91d81e8fa3678256e:
https://github.com/SAIRcompetition/Andrews-Curtis/tree/a0fd6e6f52d82c93ccc06ab91d81e8fa3678256e/competition/tools/verifier

The upstream Apache License 2.0 is preserved in LICENSE-SAIR. The local adapter lives outside this directory. Selected challenge records retain their official instance hashes and source-manifest provenance. No upstream search algorithm is included.
